categories.name: Biodegradable
categories.description: Organic waste that breaks down naturally and can be composted.
categories.examples: Food scraps, fruit peels, leaves, used tissue paper

categories.name: Recyclable
categories.description: Clean, dry materials that can be made into new products.
categories.examples: Plastic bottles, glass, metal, clean paper

categories.name: Residual
categories.description: Waste that cannot be composted or recycled here and goes to disposal.
categories.examples: Mixed garbage, soiled packaging, and sanitary waste

categories.name: Hazardous waste
categories.description: Special waste that can harm people or the environment. Use the red bin or a collection point.
categories.examples: Chemicals, batteries, busted light bulbs, and expired medicines
